ga: An iománaíocht, mar a imrítear í.

en: Fifteen a side · Two halves · Every rule
ga: Cúigear déag sa taobh · Dhá leath · Gach riail

en: Pick two counties and a ground. Play now.
ga: Roghnaigh dhá chontae agus páirc. Imir anois.

en: Groups, then knock-out games to the final.
ga: Grúpaí, ansin cluichí cnaguirlis go dtí an cluiche ceannais.

en: Sit back: two counties, played by the computer.
ga: Suigh siar: dhá chontae, agus an ríomhaire ag imirt.

en: The rules, the controls and the officials' signals.
ga: Na rialacha, na rialuithe agus comharthaí na n-oifigeach.

en: No real players or competitions: counties by their place names, every hurler invented.
ga: Gan imreoirí ná comórtais fhíora: contaetha de réir a logainmneacha, gach iománaí cumtha.

en: How long a match takes you. At 35 minutes the clock runs at about the real pace while the ball is in play: a full 70-minute match, and a real match's score.
ga: An fad a mhaireann cluiche duit. Ag 35 nóiméad ritheann an clog ar an luas ceart, nach mór, fad atá an sliotar beo: cluiche iomlán 70 nóiméad, agus scór cluiche cheart.

en: Senior county hurling has halves of 35 minutes, and the black card for denying a goal chance. Club games have halves of 30 and no black card.
ga: Tá dhá leath 35 nóiméad san iománaíocht shinsir chontae, agus an cárta dubh as seans cúil a cheilt. Tá dhá leath 30 nóiméad i gcluichí club, gan cárta dubh.

en: They give you time on the ball, and miss more often.
ga: Tugann siad am duit ar an sliotar, agus téann siad amú níos minice.

en: Quicker to the ball, harder in the tackle, sharper in front of the posts.
ga: Níos tapúla chun an tsliotair, níos crua sa tacláil, níos géire os comhair na gcuaillí.

en: The best there is: every chance taken.
ga: An chuid is fearr: gach seans tapaithe.

en: Everything is yours: four steps with the sliotar in your hand, then you must solo, pass or strike, or it is a free against you.
ga: Is leatsa gach rud: ceithre choiscéim leis an sliotar i do lámh, ansin caithfidh tú solo a dhéanamh, é a phasáil nó é a bhualadh, nó is saorphoc i do choinne é.

en: Your player puts the sliotar on his hurley himself before his fourth step. You still strike, pass and catch.
ga: Cuireann d'imreoir an sliotar ar a chamán é féin roimh an gceathrú coiscéim. Buaileann tú, pasálann tú agus beireann tú air fós.

en: As Solo, and with your thumb off the joystick your player runs for the loose ball himself.
ga: Mar Solo, agus nuair nach bhfuil d'ordóg ar an luamhán ritheann d'imreoir i ndiaidh na liathróide scaoilte é féin.

en: Lower it by itself if a match runs slowly
ga: Ísligh í féin má bhíonn cluiche mall

en: Low suits phones with 2-4 GB of memory: simpler players, fewer people in the stands, no outlines, a smaller picture. The game picks one for your phone the first time it runs.
ga: Oireann Íseal d'fhóin le 2-4 GB cuimhne: imreoirí níos simplí, níos lú daoine sna seastáin, gan imlínte, pictiúr níos lú. Roghnaíonn an cluiche ceann d'fhón an chéad uair.

en: The match was running slowly: graphics lowered a step (Settings).
ga: Bhí an cluiche ag rith go mall: ísliodh an ghrafaic céim (Socruithe).

en: About {n} frames a second and a slightly smaller picture: cooler and longer on the battery.
ga: Thart ar {n} fráma sa soicind agus pictiúr beagán níos lú: níos fuaire, agus maireann an cadhnra níos faide.

en: {n} frames a second on your {hz} Hz screen: smooth, and kind to the battery.
ga: {n} fráma sa soicind ar do scáileán {hz} Hz: réidh, agus cineálta leis an gcadhnra.

en: As many as your {hz} Hz screen shows. Smoothest, uses the most battery.
ga: An méid a thaispeánann do scáileán {hz} Hz. An ceann is réidhe, ídíonn sé an cadhnra is mó.

en: Drag each button to where your thumb wants it. The game keeps them there. Reset puts them back.
ga: Tarraing gach cnaipe chuig an áit is fearr le d'ordóg. Coinníonn an cluiche ansin iad. Cuireann Athshocraigh ar ais iad.

en: Ash & Leather is not connected with, or endorsed by, any sporting body, county board or club. The counties appear by their place names in colours of the game's own design; every player is invented. No data leaves your phone.
ga: Níl baint ag Ash & Leather le haon chomhlacht spóirt, bord contae ná club, ná níl a dtacaíocht aige. Tá na contaetha ann de réir a logainmneacha i ndathanna a dhear an cluiche féin; tá gach imreoir cumtha. Ní fhágann aon sonraí d'fhón.

en: Ash & Leather is made with the Godot Engine and the fonts below. Their licences ask that these notices be shown.
ga: Rinneadh Ash & Leather le hInneall Godot agus leis na clónna thíos. Iarrann a gceadúnais go dtaispeánfaí na fógraí seo (as Béarla, mar a scríobhadh iad).

en: A winner is needed: two halves of ten minutes' extra time, then penalties if it is still level.
ga: Tá buaiteoir ag teastáil: dhá leath deich nóiméad d'am breise, ansin pocanna éirice má bhíonn sé cothrom fós.

en: A goal cannot be scored with the hand: puck-out.
ga: Ní féidir cúl a scóráil leis an lámh: poc amach.

en: Dissent: the free moves on 30 metres
ga: Easaontas: bogann an saorphoc 30 méadar ar aghaidh

en: {name}: ten minutes in the sin bin

ga: {name}: an dara cárta buí, curtha den pháirc
Rug air gan é a imirt
Tar éis am breise; {a}-{b} ar phocanna éirice

en: The ten strongest counties play the Summer Championship; the next ten the Tier Two Cup. Two groups of five, then knock-out hurling.
ga: Imríonn na deich gcontae is láidre Craobh an tSamhraidh; an chéad deich eile Corn an Dara Sraith. Dhá ghrúpa de chúigear, ansin iománaíocht chnaguirlis.

en: Your county are the champions. The cup goes home with them.
ga: Is iad do chontae na curaidh. Tá an corn ag dul abhaile leo.

en: The championship is over for another year.
ga: Tá an chraobh thart go ceann bliana eile.

en: Your county are out. The championship goes on without them.
ga: Tá do chontae amuigh. Leanann an chraobh ar aghaidh gan iad.

en: Two points a win, one a draw, then score difference. The top two meet in the group final; its winner goes to a semi-final, its loser to a quarter-final against the other group's third.
ga: Dhá phointe ar bhua, ceann amháin ar chomhscór, ansin difríocht scóir. Imríonn an bheirt is airde cluiche ceannais an ghrúpa; téann an buaiteoir go cluiche leathcheannais, an cailliúnaí go cluiche ceathrú ceannais in aghaidh an tríú foireann sa ghrúpa eile.

en: Two points a win, one a draw, then score difference. The top two of each group go to the semi-finals.
ga: Dhá phointe ar bhua, ceann amháin ar chomhscór, ansin difríocht scóir. Téann an bheirt is airde i ngach grúpa go dtí na cluichí leathcheannais.

en: A knock-out game: a draw goes to extra time, then penalties.
ga: Cluiche cnaguirlis: má bhíonn comhscór, am breise, ansin pocanna éirice.

en: Two sides of fifteen, each with a hurley (the camán), strike the sliotar, a small leather ball, at the other side's goal: H-shaped posts 6.5 metres apart with a crossbar 2.5 metres up and a net under it.
ga: Buaileann dhá thaobh de chúigear déag, camán ag gach imreoir, an sliotar, liathróid bheag leathair, chuig cúl an taoibh eile: cuaillí i gcruth H 6.5 méadar óna chéile, trasnán 2.5 méadar suas agus líon faoi.

en: Under the crossbar is a goal, worth three points; over it, between the posts, a point. The score is written goals-points: 2-18 is 24, and beats 0-23.
ga: Faoin trasnán is cúl é, fiú trí chúilín; os a chionn, idir na cuaillí, cúilín. Scríobhtar an scór mar chúil-chúilíní: is ionann 2-18 agus 24, agus buann sé ar 0-23.

en: A goalkeeper; three full-backs; three half-backs; two midfielders; three half-forwards; three full-forwards. Each defender marks the forward facing him. Five substitutes, and three more in extra time.
ga: Cúl báire; triúr lánchúlaithe; triúr leathchúlaithe; beirt i lár na páirce; triúr leath-thosaithe; triúr lántosaithe. Marcálann gach cosantóir an tosaí os a chomhair. Cúigear ionadaithe, agus triúr eile in am breise.

en: Two halves of 35 minutes in senior county hurling, 30 in club games, with time added on for stoppages. The referee keeps the time, and starts each half by throwing the sliotar in between the four midfielders.
ga: Dhá leath 35 nóiméad san iománaíocht shinsir chontae, 30 i gcluichí club, agus am curtha leis do stadanna. Coinníonn an réiteoir an t-am, agus tosaíonn sé gach leath tríd an sliotar a chaitheamh isteach idir an ceathrar i lár na páirce.

en: You may take four steps with the sliotar in your hand. Then you must put it on your hurley (a solo) and may take it back into your hand once more. After the second catch you must play it away. On the hurley you may carry it as far as you like.
ga: Féadfaidh tú ceithre choiscéim a thógáil leis an sliotar i do lámh. Ansin caithfidh tú é a chur ar do chamán (solo) agus féadfaidh tú é a thógáil ar ais i do lámh uair amháin eile. Tar éis an dara gabháil caithfidh tú é a imirt uait. Ar an gcamán féadfaidh tú é a iompar chomh fada agus is mian leat.

en: You may pass it with your hand, struck away with a definite striking action, never thrown. A point may be scored with a hand-pass, a goal may not.
ga: Féadfaidh tú é a phasáil le do lámh, buailte uait le gníomh buailte soiléir, gan é a chaitheamh riamh. Féadtar cúilín a scóráil le pas láimhe, ach ní cúl.

en: You may not pick the sliotar off the ground with your hand: lift it with the hurley (a roll lift or a jab lift), or strike it on the ground first time.
ga: Ní féidir an sliotar a phiocadh den talamh le do lámh: ardaigh leis an gcamán é, nó buail ar an talamh é den chéad iarraidh.

en: A fair challenge: a side-to-side shoulder, hooking or blocking the striker's hurley, flicking the sliotar off a player's hurley or out of his hand.
ga: Dúshlán cothrom: gualainn ó thaobh go taobh, camán an bhuailteora a hiúcáil nó a bhlocáil, an sliotar a bhaint de chamán imreora nó as a lámh.

en: Pulling a man down, tripping, holding, pushing, charging from behind, a careless hurley, striking a player's hurley when he is not playing the ball: a free to the other side, where it happened.
ga: Imreoir a tharraingt anuas, bacadh cos, greim, brú, ruathar ón gcúl, camán míchúramach, camán imreora a bhualadh nuair nach bhfuil sé ag imirt an tsliotair: saorphoc don taobh eile, san áit ar tharla sé.

en: A yellow card is a caution; a second is a red, and he is sent off and not replaced. In senior county hurling, pulling down, tripping or a careless hurley that denies a goal chance inside the 20 m line or the arc is a black card (ten minutes in the sin bin) and a penalty.
ga: Is rabhadh an cárta buí; is dearg an dara ceann, curtar den pháirc é agus ní féidir é a ionadú. San iománaíocht shinsir chontae, má cheiltear seans cúil laistigh den líne 20 m nó den stua le tarraingt anuas, bacadh cos nó camán míchúramach, is cárta dubh é (deich nóiméad sa bhosca smachta) agus poc éirice.

en: After a score or a wide, the goalkeeper strikes the sliotar out from the small rectangle. Everyone else stands outside the 20 m line until it is struck, and it must travel 13 metres before one of his own side plays it.
ga: Tar éis scóir nó iarrachta amú, buaileann an cúl báire an sliotar amach ón gcearnóg bheag. Seasann gach duine eile taobh amuigh den líne 20 m go mbuailtear é, agus caithfidh sé 13 mhéadar a thaisteal sula n-imríonn duine dá thaobh féin é.

en: Taken where the foul was: lifted with the hurley and struck, opponents 13 metres away. A foul by a defender inside his 20 m line gives a free from the 20 m line; in the large rectangle a technical foul gives a free from its centre.
ga: Tógtha san áit a raibh an chalaois: ardaithe leis an gcamán agus buailte, an freasúra 13 mhéadar uaidh. Calaois ag cosantóir laistigh dá líne 20 m: saorphoc ón líne 20 m; sa chearnóg mhór, calaois theicniúil: saorphoc óna lár.

en: When a defender puts the ball over his own end line wide of the posts, the attackers strike a free from the 65 m line opposite where it crossed.
ga: Nuair a chuireann cosantóir an sliotar thar a chúlline féin, lasmuigh de na cuaillí, buaileann na tosaithe saorphoc ón líne 65 m os comhair na háite ar thrasnaigh sé.

en: Over the sideline, the other side strike it back in from where it crossed, off the ground, with opponents 13 metres back.
ga: Thar an taobhlíne, buaileann an taobh eile isteach é ón áit ar thrasnaigh sé, den talamh, an freasúra 13 mhéadar siar.

en: For an aggressive foul by a defender in his large rectangle, or a foul that denies a goal chance. Struck from the 20 m line, one defender on the goal line, everyone else outside the 20 m line and the arc.
ga: As calaois ionsaitheach ag cosantóir ina chearnóg mhór, nó as calaois a cheileann seans cúil. Buailte ón líne 20 m, cosantóir amháin ar an gcúlline, gach duine eile taobh amuigh den líne 20 m agus den stua.

en: In a knock-out game a draw goes to two halves of ten minutes' extra time. Still level: five penalties each, only goals count, then sudden death.
ga: I gcluiche cnaguirlis, téann comhscór go dhá leath deich nóiméad d'am breise. Más cothrom fós: cúig phoc éirice an taobh, níl ach cúil ag comhaireamh, ansin bás tobann.

en: Every hurler wears a helmet with a face guard: the rule at every grade since 2010.
ga: Caitheann gach iománaí clogad le gardaí aghaidhe: an riail ag gach grád ó 2010.

en: Your thumb anywhere on the left of the screen is a joystick. Your player has the gold ring.
ga: Is luamhán stiúrtha d'ordóg áit ar bith ar thaobh na láimhe clé den scáileán. Tá an fáinne óir ar d'imreoir.

en: The small SWITCH button changes your player to the teammate best placed for the ball. When the ball is struck to a teammate you become him.
ga: Athraíonn an cnaipe beag ATHRAIGH d'imreoir go dtí an comhimreoir is fearr suite don sliotar. Nuair a bhuailtear an sliotar chuig comhimreoir, is tusa é.

en: STRIKE with the joystick toward the posts (or let go of it) is a shot for a point. Pushed elsewhere, it is a long ball to the teammate that way.
ga: BUAIL leis an luamhán i dtreo na gcuaillí (nó gan é) is iarracht ar chúilín é. Brúite áit éigin eile, is liathróid fhada chuig an gcomhimreoir sa treo sin é.

en: Inside about 30 metres GOAL drives it low at the net, away from the goalkeeper.
ga: Laistigh de thart ar 30 méadar, buaileann CÚL íseal é sa líon, ón gcúl báire.

en: PASS hand-passes to the teammate the joystick points at (a short strike if he is further, or the sliotar is on your hurley).
ga: Déanann PAS pas láimhe chuig an gcomhimreoir a thaispeánann an luamhán (buille gearr má tá sé níos faide uait, nó an sliotar ar do chamán).

en: SOLO puts the sliotar from your hand onto your hurley before your four steps are up (the dots over your player count them). HAND takes it back, your second catch.
ga: Cuireann SOLO an sliotar ó do lámh ar do chamán sula mbíonn do cheithre choiscéim caite (comhaireann na poncanna os cionn d'imreora iad). Tógann LÁMH ar ais é, do dhara gabháil.

en: When the sliotar comes near: CATCH it in the air, or LIFT it off the ground with the hurley.
ga: Nuair a thagann an sliotar in aice leat: BEIR air san aer, nó ARDAIGH den talamh é leis an gcamán.

en: PULL strikes a loose ball first time, on the ground or in the air, without taking it.
ga: Buaileann TARRAING liathróid scaoilte den chéad iarraidh, ar an talamh nó san aer, gan breith air.

en: Near the man on the ball: TACKLE (a shoulder, a hook or a flick, as the moment needs); BLOCK when he goes to strike. From behind, or too late, it is a free.
ga: In aice leis an imreoir leis an sliotar: TACLÁIL (gualainn, hiúcáil nó bain de, de réir mar is gá); BAC nuair a théann sé chun buailte. Ón gcúl, nó rómhall, is saorphoc é.

en: Your puck-out: LONG (aim with the joystick) or SHORT to a back. Your free, 65 or sideline: STRIKE at the posts or PASS to a teammate. A penalty: aim, then GOAL.
ga: Do phoc amach: FADA (aimsigh leis an luamhán) nó GEARR chuig cúlaí. Do shaorphoc, 65 nó poc sleasa: BUAIL ar na cuaillí nó PAS chuig comhimreoir. Poc éirice: aimsigh, ansin CÚL.

en: Settings > Help with the ball: Off, Solo (he solos before his fourth step) or Full (he runs for loose balls too).
ga: Socruithe > Cabhair leis an sliotar: Múchta, Solo (déanann sé solo roimh an gceathrú coiscéim) nó Iomlán (ritheann sé i ndiaidh liathróidí scaoilte freisin).

en: WASD or the arrows to run; Space, J, K and L for the buttons; Q to switch; Esc to pause.
ga: WASD nó na saigheada chun rith; Spás, J, K agus L do na cnaipí; Q chun athrú; Esc le sos a ghlacadh.

en: The umpire waves the white flag.
ga: Croitheann an maor cúil an bhratach bhán.

en: The umpire waves the green flag.
ga: Croitheann an maor cúil an bhratach ghlas.

en: The umpire crosses his arms over his head.
ga: Croiseann an maor cúil a lámha os cionn a chinn.

en: The umpire raises an arm straight up, then points in at the 65 m line.
ga: Ardaíonn an maor cúil lámh díreach suas, ansin díríonn sé isteach ar an líne 65 m.

en: The referee's whistle, then his arm held out toward the goal the free attacks.
ga: Feadóg an réiteora, ansin a lámh sínte i dtreo an chúil a bhfuil an saorphoc ag ionsaí air.

en: One arm held straight up for up to five seconds: play on. If nothing comes of it, he brings it back for the free.
ga: Lámh amháin díreach suas ar feadh suas le cúig soicind: ar aghaidh leis an imirt. Mura dtagann aon rud as, tugann sé ar ais é don saorphoc.

en: He holds the card up to the player; for the black card, then ten fingers for the ten minutes in the sin bin.
ga: Taispeánann sé an cárta don imreoir; don chárta dubh, ansin deich méar do na deich nóiméad sa bhosca smachta.

en: The linesman holds his flag out the way the cut goes.
ga: Coinníonn an maor líne a bhratach sínte sa treo a dtéann an poc.

en: Drag on the left to run. The buttons on the right come up as you need them. Over the bar is a point; in the net, a goal (3).
ga: Tarraing ar chlé chun rith. Tagann na cnaipí ar dheis nuair a bhíonn gá leo. Thar an trasnán, cúilín; san eangach, cúl (3).

en: Drag your thumb on the left to run. You are the man with the gold ring.
ga: Tarraing d'ordóg ar chlé chun rith. Is tusa an fear leis an bhfáinne óir.

en: The sliotar is near: CATCH it in the air or LIFT it off the ground. PULL strikes it first time.
ga: Tá an sliotar gar duit: BEIR air san aer nó ARDAIGH den talamh é. Buaileann TARRAING é den chéad iarraidh.

en: In your hand you may take four steps (the dots count them). SOLO puts it on your hurley.
ga: I do lámh, tá ceithre choiscéim agat (comhaireann na poncanna iad). Cuireann SOLO ar do chamán é.

en: On the hurley, run as far as you like. STRIKE for the posts or PASS to a teammate.
ga: Ar an gcamán, rith chomh fada agus is mian leat. BUAIL ar na cuaillí nó PAS chuig comhimreoir.

en: In range: push the joystick toward the posts and STRIKE. Over the bar is a point.
ga: Faoi raon: brúigh an luamhán i dtreo na gcuaillí agus BUAIL. Thar an trasnán, cúilín.

en: Close in: GOAL drives it at the net, worth three points. STRIKE over the bar for one.
ga: Gar don chúl: tiomáineann CÚL san eangach é, trí chúilín. BUAIL thar an trasnán ar cheann.

en: He has the ball: TACKLE from the side or the front. From behind, it is a free to them.
ga: Tá an sliotar aige: TACLÁIL ón taobh nó ón tosach. Ón gcúl, is saorphoc dóibh é.

en: The ball is far from you: SWITCH takes the teammate best placed for it.
ga: Tá an sliotar i bhfad uait: tógann ATHRAIGH an comhimreoir is fearr suite dó.

en: Lost the sliotar? A white dot marks it, and off the screen an arrow at the edge points to it.
ga: Cá bhfuil an sliotar? Marcálann ponc bán é, agus lasmuigh den scáileán taispeánann saighead ar an imeall é.

en: Your puck-out: LONG down the field (aim with the joystick) or SHORT to a back.
ga: Do phoc amach: FADA síos an pháirc (aimsigh leis an luamhán) nó GEARR chuig cúlaí.

en: Your free: STRIKE for the posts or PASS to a teammate. Wait, and it is taken for you.
ga: Do shaorphoc: BUAIL ar na cuaillí nó PAS chuig comhimreoir. Fan, agus tógfar duit é.

en: A penalty: aim with the joystick, then GOAL. Only the goalkeeper stands in your way.
ga: Poc éirice: aimsigh leis an luamhán, ansin CÚL. Níl ach an cúl báire romhat.

en: Too many steps: a free to them. SOLO it onto your hurley before the fourth step.
ga: An iomarca coiscéimeanna: saorphoc dóibh. Cuir SOLO ar do chamán roimh an gceathrú coiscéim.

en: Short tips through a match, each the first time it is needed. On for your first match.
ga: Leideanna gearra le linn cluiche, gach ceann an chéad uair a bhíonn gá leis. Ar siúl do do chéad chluiche.

en: Tap a tired man, then the one to bring on. The change is made at the next break in play.
ga: Tapáil fear tuirseach, ansin an té a thiocfaidh isteach. Déantar an t-athrú ag an gcéad bhriseadh eile san imirt.
Cé a thiocfaidh isteach in áit {name}?

en: {on} on for {off} at the next break
ga: {on} isteach in áit {off} ag an gcéad bhriseadh eile

en: A half-forward (12) drops back in front of the full-back line and marks no one: an extra man in defence, one fewer up front.
ga: Titeann leath-thosaí (12) siar os comhair líne na lánchúl agus ní mharcálann sé aon duine: fear breise sa chosaint, duine níos lú chun tosaigh.

en: The corner-forward (13) comes out to the half-forward line, and his marker with him: two left inside with room to run.
ga: Tagann an cúinne-thosaí (13) amach go líne na leath-thosaithe, agus a mharcálaí leis: fágtar beirt istigh le spás le rith.

en: Short to a free back keeps the ball but invites the press; long into the middle is won about half the time.
ga: Coinníonn poc gearr chuig cúlaí saor an sliotar ach meallann sé an brú; buaitear poc fada isteach sa lár thart ar leath an ama.

en: {team} drop a sweeper back to hold the lead
ga: Scuabaire siar ag {team} chun an tosach a choinneáil
An séasúr seo a chailleadh? Tapáil arís
